name: roundcube/message_security_info
description: Shows a Message Security link on received messages, its icon coloured by the sender-authentication verdict (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and by whether the DKIM signing domain aligns with the visible From address. Clicking it opens a popup with the parsed per-mechanism results, the transport encryption state and the raw authentication headers. Reads the receiving server's Authentication-Results and Received-SPF headers; falls back to reporting a raw DKIM-Signature as present but unverified.
